name: f3d
readme_excerpt: F3D - fast and minimalist 3D viewer By the F3D-APP Foundation. F3D (pronounced /fɛd/) is a fast and minimalist 3D viewer desktop application. It supports many file formats, from digital content to scientific datasets, including glTF, USD, STL, STEP, PLY, OBJ, FBX, and Alembic. It can show animations, generate thumbnails, and provide many rendering and texturing options including real-time physically based rendering and raytracing.
